# tc blocks

Tweet-id lines of the form `tc <id> o=p`, split into blocks of 100.
Order is the original lexicographic order of the decimal ids (shorter ids interleave with longer ones).
Files are named `NNN__<first-id>-<last-id>.txt` so they sort in that same order.
The last block is shorter than 100.

Total items: 5903
Blocks: 60

Created-at values are decoded from the Twitter snowflake timestamp and are the earliest and latest id inside the block. They are not the first and last lines, because lexicographic order is not chronological.
